document: PRD-002 Benchmark Evidence Console wireframe fixture registry
purpose: Bind every canonical UI frame to real accepted evidence, real published-reference metadata, or an explicit missing/schema state. Canonical wireframes must not invent measured values.

frames.name: Application shell / current snapshot
frames.notes: Validates evidence snapshot identity separately from repository head.

frames.name: Overview / North Star
frames.notes: Uses LME retrieval, AgentMemBench currentness, #591 latency, governance, and explicit QA/BEAM missing states.

frames.name: Capability posture inspector
frames.notes: Currentness seed uses new-fact/staleness/latest-first and self-validity evidence_gap.

frames.name: Compare / valid same-harness set
frames.notes: LongMemEval_S v2 session AM vs Mem0; published context isolated.

frames.name: Compare / non-comparable selection
frames.notes: Real mismatch: retrieval recall_all@5 vs end-to-end QA accuracy.

frames.name: Benchmarks index
frames.notes: LME, PrecisionMemBench, AgentMemBench currentness, BEAM not-run.

frames.name: Benchmark profile detail
frames.notes: All metrics and identities are accepted v2 lane data.

frames.name: Changes timeline
frames.notes: Uses actual pre-remediation and accepted later evidence.

frames.name: Before/after revision comparison
frames.notes: Uses actual historical/current deltas and first_baseline/evidence_gap states.

frames.name: Failure Explorer aggregate
frames.notes: Uses real proposition-recognition failure structure; MESA stage taxonomy remains explicitly unavailable until #694 evidence exists.

frames.name: Failure case detail
sources: future row-level index over accepted benchmark evidence
frames.notes: No case id or text may be invented before the row-level catalog exposes it.

frames.name: Coverage matrix
frames.notes: Measured/partial/not-run states only.

frames.name: Coverage-gap inspector
frames.notes: Shows missing AM scale evidence alongside clearly separated market context.

frames.name: Evidence index / run browser
frames.notes: Uses actual workflow ids and system revisions.

frames.name: Run detail
frames.notes: Single real accepted run.

frames.name: Evidence / comparability inspector
frames.notes: Explains actual exact comparison.

frames.name: Snapshot selector / history
frames.notes: Validates historical/current distinction.

frames.name: Historical shared snapshot
frames.notes: Uses revision-bound accepted evidence.

frames.name: Share / export
frames.notes: Measured content is real; export control metadata is schema contract.

frames.name: Methodology / metric glossary
frames.notes: Uses actual metric names and definitions/reading rules.

frames.name: No same-harness comparator
frames.notes: Real current evidence posture.

frames.name: Blocked / unsupported evidence
sources: current dashboard LLM-judged profile blocked state
frames.notes: Must not render as zero.

frames.name: Failed attempted run with previous accepted evidence
frames.notes: No synthetic failed score.

frames.name: Catalog stale relative to repository
frames.notes: Real current stale-catalog condition.

frames.name: Invalid or unavailable snapshot
frames.notes: No automatic substitution with current evidence.

frames.name: Mobile Overview
frames.notes: Responsive transformation only.

frames.name: Mobile pair comparison
frames.notes: Pair-only narrow-screen representation.

frames.name: Mobile evidence/run detail
frames.notes: Preserves run identity on narrow screens.

frames.name: Tablet comparison matrix
frames.notes: Three-column medium-width validation.
